shared_elements: human figure(s) rendered in low relief
winged/spread motif near the top of the field
incised linear script-like or symbolic signs
division of the field into horizontal zones/registers
upright slab-shaped monument with carved front face
justification: Both are upright monuments with low-relief carving that includes human forms, a broad winged/outspread element near the top, and a circular disc, with content loosely stacked in horizontal zones. But A shows multiple small profile figures seated and standing in narrative registers accompanied by dense rows of script signs, whereas B is a single massive frontal figure whose head, headdress, pectoral disc and belt dominate the whole surface — quite different compositional schemes, proportions and rendering conventions.
